entries.task: Predicting fluid flow fields across a range of Angle of Attack (AoA) and Mach number values. Training set: AoAtrain = {-10, -9,..., 9, 10}, Machtrain = {0.2, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.7}. Test set: AoAtest = {-10, -9,..., 9, 10}, Machtest = {0.25, 0.45, 0.65}
